results.note: Fundatio abbatiae S. Augustini (Foundation of Abbey of St. Augustine) — no English translation found in scholarly sources or CCEL. Medieval abbey history texts of this type typically remain in Latin.
Vita S. Sulpicii — copyrighted English translation by Sarah Brush available in scholarly medieval hagiography collections. CPL/Migne PL edition, Merovingian-period vita.
Historia translationis corporis S. Isidori (History of Translation of St. Isidore's Body) — Latin text available on Wikisource, but no English translation found in searches or CCEL.
Chronica regum Visigothorum (Chronicle of Visigothic Kings) — a seventh-century register/laterculus of Visigothic rulers; no modern English translation located despite MGH editions.
Chronologia Gothicorum (Chronology of the Goths) — no English translation found. Medieval chronicle/chronological text with limited modern study.
De activa atque contemplativa vita (On Active and Contemplative Life) — philosophical treatise; no English translation found despite topic prominence in medieval thought.

De conflictu vitiorum et virtutum (On the Conflict of Vices and Virtues) — attributed to Pseudo-Augustinus/Ambrosius Autpertus in some sources; Online Books Page lists English translation but no details provided. Status unclear: may be copyrighted scholarly edition.
De dogmatibus ecclesiasticis (On Ecclesiastical Dogmas) — anonymous medieval version; no English translation found. Not to be confused with Gennadius of Marseilles' work of same title.
De numeris (On Numbers) — philosophical/mathematical treatise; no English translation located. Medieval number theory texts of this type rarely translated.

De ortu et obitu Patrum (On the Lives and Deaths of the Fathers) — Migne lists as Auctor incertus, but sources indicate attribution to Isidore of Seville. No modern English translation found; biographies of OT/NT patriarchs and matriarchs.
Differentiae (Distinctions) — medieval glossary/philosophical text on semantic/logical differences; no English translation found.
Exhortatio humilitatis (Exhortation to Humility) — penitential/moral exhortation; no English translation found in sources.
Exhortatio poenitendi (Exhortation to Repentance) — 174-line rhythmic hexameter poem on penitence; manuscripts exist but no English translation documented in searches.

Expositio in Canticum canticorum (Commentary on Song of Songs) — multiple medieval commentaries exist with this title (Honorius Augustodunensis, Williram, others); no translation of this specific anonymous version verified.
Expositio in missa (Exposition of the Mass) — liturgical/theological commentary; medieval manuscripts exist but no English translation found in CCEL or standard sources.
Glossae in sacram Scripturam (Glosses on Sacred Scripture) — biblical glosses sometimes falsely attributed to Isidore; no English translation found.
Lamentum poenitentiae (Lamentation of Repentance) — alphabetic hymn in rhythmic trochaic septenaries on penitence; no English translation documented.
Norma vivendi (Standard/Rule of Living) — moral/devotional treatise; no English translation found despite similar works like Liber de modo bene vivendi being translated.
Oratio contra insidias diaboli (Prayer Against Devil's Snares) — brief devotional prayer/text; no English translation found.
Oratio pro correptione vitae (Prayer for Correction of Life) — prose penitential text in voice of repentant sinner; no English translation found despite existence in scholarly editions.

Sententiae (Sentences) — spans volumes 83 & 184; in some sources attributed to Isidore of Seville. Migne lists as Auctor incertus. Over 500 medieval manuscripts attested; no modern English translation found.
Sermones (Sermons) — large collection spanning volumes 83 & 177 (128,316 words); nature of content and attribution unclear. Likely no full English translation given size and anonymous status.
Testimonia divinae Scripturae (Testimonies of Divine Scripture) — scriptural florilegia/quotations; no English translation found.
Benedictio aquae (Blessing of Water) — liturgical blessing text; scholarly treatments exist in Latin but no complete English translation of this specific Migne text found.
Benedictio panis (Blessing of Bread) — brief liturgical blessing; no English translation found.
Missa S. Pelagii martyris (Mass of Saint Pelagius the Martyr) — liturgical propers for saint's mass; no complete English translation of this specific medieval text found.

Breviarium (Breviary) — large liturgical compilation (262,569 words, vol. 86); the Syon Breviary was translated to English (2015), but this specific Migne breviary text has no documented English translation.
Cantica (Canticles/Songs) — liturgical canticles; no English translation of this anonymous Migne vol. 86 text found in searches.
Commune (Common of Saints) — liturgical common propers for various saint categories; no full English translation found.
Festa addita (Added Feasts) — supplementary liturgical feast texts; no English translation found.

Horae canonicae (Canonical Hours) — liturgical office texts for seven hours of daily prayer; general forms exist in English (primer tradition), but this specific medieval anonymous text has no documented translation.
Hymni (Hymns) — liturgical hymn collection spanning vols. 86-87; no comprehensive English translation found despite liturgical hymn translation tradition.
Psalterium (Psalter) — liturgical psalter text; no English translation of this Migne vol. 86 text found. Medieval psalmody translated sporadically but not this collection.
Regula (Rule) — brief monastic rule (999 words, vol. 86); likely Benedictine or Columbanian in character. Insufficient search results to confirm authorship or translation status.
Sanctorale (Sanctoral/Lives of Saints) — large collection of liturgical propers and vitae for saints (85,439 words, vol. 86); no comprehensive English translation found.
Dissertatio de judiciis Dei (Dissertation on God's Judgments) — theological treatise on divine judgment; no English translation found.
Formulae veteres (Ancient Formula Collection) — collection of charter templates/model documents; scholarly editions exist (MGH Formulae) but no English translation of this specific text located.
Praemonitio (Preface/Foreword) — brief prefatory text; no English translation found.
Tabula insigniorum (Index of Notable Matters) — index/table text; no English translation found.
Vita Amandi (Life of Saint Amand) — seventh-century hagiography of famous missionary; Polish translation documented, but no English translation found in searches.

Vita Balthildis (Life of Saint Balthild, Queen of the Franks) — Merovingian-period vita; included in copyrighted collections: 'Sainted Women of the Dark Ages' and 'Late Merovingian France' (Fouracre & Gerberding).
Miracula Joannis Reomaensis (Miracles of John of Reomay) — hagiographic miracles attributed to Saint John of Reomay; no English translation found.

Regula Magistri (Rule of the Master) — copyrighted English translation by Luke Eberle OSB (1977, Liturgical Press); first English translation of this major monastic rule. Critical edition with extensive introduction.

Regula ad virgines (Rule for Virgins) — Albrecht Diem has published critical editions with translation (Columbanische Klosterregeln 2016, The Pursuit of Salvation 2021); English translation available in scholarly contexts.
Sententia de regulis devotarum (Judgment/Rule on Religious Devotion) — brief monastic text (134 words); no English translation found.
